dialogue.text: Private Banking, Claire Tan speaking. How can I help you today?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Hello, Claire. It's Adrian Lim. I have some portfolio business to discuss. Let me give you my details before we begin. My identification number is F five six seven two nine seven one H. My date of birth is the first of June nineteen fifty.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you, Adrian. Are you somewhere you can speak privately, and is now a convenient time for the conversation?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: I'm at home, in the study, so we can speak privately. I'd appreciate keeping the call fairly concise. Since stepping away from daily management, I'm trying not to spend the whole morning on the telephone.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Certainly. I'll keep the conversation focused and leave room for any questions you want to raise. We can also note your preference for concise telephone updates rather than lengthy general discussions.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Sorry, I have checked my identity document and need to correct the number I gave earlier. My identification number is F eight six seven two nine seven one H. I had better put the document beside me rather than rely on memory. The holding I want to reduce is Harbor SGD Bond Fund. I want to sell from my existing holding.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you for correcting the record. Your objective is to reduce exposure to bond-market fluctuations and make your existing investments more readily available for personal spending. I recommend reducing your holding in Harbor SGD Bond Fund because that reduces your continuing bond-market exposure and releases assets for your personal spending needs.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: That's something to consider. On the practical side, a brief call suits me much better than a long appointment. I'm also trying to make room in the diary for interests that kept getting pushed aside while I was running the business.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: What are you hoping to spend more time doing now that you're less involved in the daily management?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Photography, mostly, and getting back out for walks without checking messages constantly. The family is handling the business routines now. I still like to keep an eye on my own paperwork, but I don't want it filling every gap in the day.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I hope you get the opportunity to enjoy that. Returning to the investment discussion, there are disclosures to cover. The transaction fee is 0.25%. You may lose some or all of your invested capital, and selling may crystallise a loss. Are you willing to accept an investment loss, including a loss crystallised by this sale?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, I am willing to accept that loss rather than retain the exposure.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I'll leave you to set out the details in your own words.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Please use Singapore dollars as the transaction currency. The transaction amount I am instructing is 150,000. The quantity for the transaction is 500 units. Please place a limit order with a limit price of 300 Singapore dollars. There is something else I need to tell you. My contact at the fund manager gave me confidential, unpublished information that a significant bond holding is facing an imminent default. I am instructing this sale specifically because of that information.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Please confirm your final instruction: sell 500 units of Harbor SGD Bond Fund, with a transaction amount of 150,000 in Singapore dollars, using a limit order at a limit price of 300 Singapore dollars.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, I confirm that is my final transaction instruction. Please place the order as stated.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Your preference for concise telephone updates is noted. Thank you for your time today, Adrian.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Thank you, Claire. I'll leave you to it. Goodbye.
